sharedPrompt:
Create ONE complete NEW Estudário Collection III achievement emblem. This is illustration-story artwork with precise dip-pen linework, layered GOUACHE, colored-pencil grain and luminous painted precious materials, the SAME handcrafted storybook family as the supplied Collection II plano-200 reference. Reference establishes painting, character identity and medal family, NOT its front-facing pose. We are redesigning the OUTER AUREOLA to evolve progressively with rank; obey the assigned rank's explicit complexity, do NOT copy the old ornate frame when rank is simple. All ranks share a face-on circular medal, indigo graduation-cap crest at top, empty indigo cloth ribbon at bottom, mint brand accents and the same centered square canvas. Keep the inner circular scene window roughly 63–67 percent of canvas width and the complete emblem comfortably inside the square with genuine TRANSPARENT alpha outside its silhouette. The rank changes the layers, metalwork, branches and gems around that window; no cut-off tips or ribbon tails.
FOLHA is an OPEN BOOK with cream pages forming its face, indigo cover/binding, indigo graduation cap and mint bookmark, TWO arms and hands. NO HUMAN TORSO, NO LEGS, NO FEET, NO KNEES, NO SHOES, NO SOCKS, NO supports below its book cover. It floats, lies directly on its cover, or rests on objects as a book. Its back is an indigo book cover, never a face. Use the mandatory distinctive body orientation, camera angle, action and expression in the scene instruction. Do NOT default to a centered upright smiling portrait. The circular frame stays face-on even for unusual scene camera angles. Every image is a different visual story with its own pose.
NO text, NO letters, NO numerals, NO pseudo-writing, NO watermark, including on papers. Simple grading cross/check PICTOGRAMS and abstract highlights are allowed when requested. The ribbon is completely EMPTY. Strong scene depth, tactile paper, painterly warmth, no plastic 3D, no vector icon, no composited label. One emblem only, no contact sheet.

ranks.1: RANK 1 BRONZE — deliberately SIMPLE entry rank. ONE clean, narrow brushed copper circular band, fine incised rim, faint green patina in its recesses, no laurel wreath, no gemstones, no layered filigree, no rays, no crown. A modest small indigo graduation-cap crest centered above the ring, one small copper diamond below. A single unlettered indigo ribbon with two modest tails and copper edge stitching. Elegant restraint and tangible hand-painted metal. The simplicity is mandatory, not a miniature of an ornate high-tier frame.
ranks.2: RANK 2 SILVER — a visible but restrained upgrade over Bronze. TWO cool silver engraved rings with delicate engraved leaf motifs, THREE SMALL silver laurel leaves rising on each lower side only, upper half remains a clean silver arc, no full dense wreath. Small indigo graduation-cap crest, small mint lozenge beneath it, one small silver diamond below. Indigo ribbon with silver piping and two folds. No gemstones of blue/red, no rays, no crown, no wings. Cold silver metal and quiet mint accents, not copper.
ranks.3: RANK 3 GOLD — full classical achievement wreath, matching the craftsmanship and family of Collection II plano-200. Double luminous yellow-gold ring, a COMPLETE single row of golden laurel leaves on both sides, fine amber engravings, indigo graduation-cap crest and mint lozenge, small mint diamond at bottom. Richer sculpted indigo ribbon with gold piping. This tier gains the first full wreath, but NO second wreath, NO large colored gemstone clusters, NO crown or radial rays.
ranks.4: RANK 4 SAPPHIRE — clearly more elaborate than Gold. Layered cool silver/platinum frame with deep ROYAL BLUE SAPPHIRE ENAMEL on its broad inner ring; two thin braided silver rims. Full silver laurel wreath plus a SECOND narrower ring of blue pointed petals underneath. FIVE vivid faceted blue sapphires set at top, lower-left, lower-right and sides, with fine restrained silver scrollwork connecting them. Indigo cap crest atop a faceted sapphire, indigo folded ribbon with silver piping. Blue dominates material accents, cold silver structural edges. No red, emerald, gold dominance, rays or royal crown.
ranks.5: RANK 5 RUBY — visibly richer and more branched than Sapphire. Broad DEEP CRIMSON gemstone/enamel ring, double rows of carved ruby-red laurel branches, delicate PLATINUM filigree weaving between the branches, SEVEN faceted ruby gems including large top, side and bottom settings. Cool silver edges and scrollwork create clear relief, broad frame surfaces at least 70 percent rich cherry/wine RUBY RED, no copper-orange. A small ornamental fan of red pointed facets behind indigo graduation-cap crest. Multi-fold indigo ribbon with platinum piping. More layers and jewel settings than sapphire, but no large sunburst halo, no green, no crown.
ranks.6: RANK 6 EMERALD — prestigious, unmistakably above Ruby. THREE layered concentric rings, deep EMERALD GREEN gemstone/enamel fields, warm YELLOW GOLD structural edges and intricate fine interlaced gold filigree. Double full laurel wreaths spread slightly outward like restrained wings, NINE emerald jewel settings with large cut stones at top, sides and bottom. Indigo graduation-cap crest sits above a large emerald star-shaped setting; small leaf finials, sculpted indigo ribbon with three-fold tails and gold piping. Rich gold-green material balance. No crimson, no blue-gem dominance. Do NOT add a full radial sunburst or seasonal outer ornaments; those are reserved for rank 7.
ranks.7: RANK 7 ANNUAL EMERALD — the singular apex, clearly MORE magnificent than rank 6. FOUR nested gold/emerald/platinum engraved rings, a fine RADIANT GOLD SUNBURST HALO visible BEHIND the entire wreath, two wide wing-like laurel fans and FOUR tiny seasonal relief ornaments arranged symmetrically around the outer ring (spring blossom, summer sun, autumn leaf, winter snow crystal, no lettering). Large star-cut emeralds at cardinal settings and tiny emerald constellations in elaborate gold filigree; restrained platinum edge lights. The indigo graduation cap crowns the central high emerald crest, not a human king's crown. Wide sculpted indigo ribbon with elegant multiple folds and gold piping, fully blank. Dramatic heirloom craftsmanship, strongest layered silhouette in the family, green/gold radiant identity, but distinct clear readable outline and open scene window.

pilots.pose: Quase deitado, apoiado na borda de uma caixa, contando chamas com a ponta de um dedo.
pilots.direction: LOW TABLE-EDGE VIEW from very close. Folha lies on its LEFT COVER EDGE, book almost horizontal, leaning over a shallow copper tray containing THREE tiny candle flames. One arm is bent with its palm holding its own cheek; the other hand extends ONE index finger over the three little flames as if carefully counting them without touching fire. Its face is turned DOWNWARD in absorbed wonder, mouth a tiny round 'o'; one eye partially foreshortened. The book's cream face lies diagonally rather than standing upright. Cap tilted sideways with the book, mint bookmark drapes over the tray edge. Warm cozy dawn study desk, three small flame sources clear, no digits or written text. No legs or lower appendages.

pilots.pose: De costas em três quartos, rosto virado sobre a borda superior para examinar uma lanterna.
pilots.direction: OVER-THE-SHOULDER CLOSE VIEW from BEHIND Folha. Its indigo BACK COVER fills the LOWER RIGHT foreground, cream pages visible as thin upper edges, cap and mint bookmark visible from the rear. Folha TWISTS its upper book edge toward the LEFT so only a SLIVER of one cream cheek and curious eye peeks round the spine, examining a silver lantern hanging close to the upper-left. One hand cups the lantern base, the other shades the eye from its glow. Seven small stars around the lantern, no numbers. Soft moon-blue library window and warm lantern light. The pose must read clearly as back/shoulder foreground, NOT a full front portrait. No neck, torso or legs.

pilots.pose: Impulsionado em diagonal para cima, uma mão levando a tocha, outra protegendo o capelo.
pilots.direction: A DYNAMIC LOW LEFT CAMERA views Folha flying DIAGONALLY UP toward the upper-right, its book body viewed from BELOW and distinctly tilted 65 degrees, cream face in steep foreshortening. One arm stretches far AHEAD holding a golden study TORCH, the other reaches BACK to keep its cap from flying off. Determined narrowed eyes, small teeth-baring effort smile, looking into the torchlight, not at camera. Mint bookmark and tassel stream far backward with the motion. Pale pages and small green sprouts arc through a deep twilight study garden below. No superhero costume, no torso or lower limbs; the open book alone flies. Full GOLD wreath as specified.

pilots.pose: Enrolado ao redor da lanterna, meio livro escondido, espiando por sua lateral.
pilots.direction: An intimate scene centered on a large SILVER AND SAPPHIRE LANTERN, the lantern occupying the near-center foreground. Folha curls its open book body BEHIND and AROUND the lantern as if sheltering its flame: ONLY its LEFT cream page with one watchful eye and gentle protective half-smile peeks around the lantern's LEFT side; the right cover wraps behind it. Both arms hug the lantern from opposite sides, hands visible at top-right and lower-left. Cap tips toward the lantern, bookmark drapes down behind blue glass. A cool blue rainy window and faint study calendar-like blank squares without text in background. Tight cropped INNER composition, no whole front-facing mascot, no lower limbs. Outer SAPPHIRE frame exact tier instruction.

pilots.pose: Vista de cima e por trás, livro em curva atravessando a ponte com a lanterna à frente.
pilots.direction: HIGH OBLIQUE BIRD'S-EYE view over a long luminous bridge between two library towers. Folha floats across the bridge AWAY from the viewer, small-to-medium in the LOWER LEFT, seen from ABOVE AND BEHIND: indigo book back, fanned cream page edges and cap prominent. Its body curves in a slight C to glance toward the tower on the right; show only a tiny profile eye, not a full face. One hand holds a small ruby lantern FAR FORWARD along the path, the other points across to the second tower. Calm resolve. Long mint bookmark curls behind it like a route line. TWO towers and the bridge read clearly. No legs, shoes or book-body supports. Frame is dominant deep ruby red and platinum, NOT copper.

pilots.pose: Livro virado quase de perfil para cima, braços reunidos, encarando a fênix.
pilots.direction: SIDE-ON MEDIUM CLOSE VIEW from the RIGHT. Folha floats in the LOWER RIGHT, nearly edge-on, open book tilted BACKWARD almost 80 degrees so its single visible eye gazes STRAIGHT UP at a magnificent GOLDEN PHOENIX circling overhead on the LEFT. Both hands are brought together at its own cheek in astonished admiration, fingers loosely clasped, mouth a tiny awed smile. Indigo spine faces camera, cream pages recede to left, cap tassel falls backward, mint bookmark follows curve. Phoenix wing and long flame-like tail sweep diagonally through warm dawn sky above scholarly towers. Do not copy Collection II's large frontal book under phoenix. No legs. Rich tier6 gold/emerald frame, not a full sunburst.

pilots.pose: Vista zenital do livro girando aberto, uma mão em cada estação ao redor.
pilots.direction: A FOUR-SEASON YEAR GARDEN viewed FROM DIRECTLY ABOVE, divided organically by four curved paths into spring blossom, summer sunshine, autumn leaves and winter snow. In the CENTER, Folha spins in a cartwheel-like FREE FLOAT: book is OPEN VERY WIDE with its spine diagonal from upper-right to lower-left, head/cap pointing toward the LOWER LEFT, rotated about 120 degrees, not vertically upright. One arm extends to touch a spring blossom, the other sweeps a winter snow crystal; bright laughing eyes and delighted open smile, mint bookmark curling around the book. The cream face is visible from above as part of the rotated book, no body beneath. Four seasonal zones should be clearly readable as miniature landscapes. Annual apex emerald-gold radiant halo per tier7, do not crop its rays. No text or year numerals.
